Interaction Main Fields 10 fields
Field Name Original Name Definition Use Case / Why Example
interaction_id interactionId(Pk) Unique sequence used to identify each interaction Ensures no duplicate entries that could inflate engagement metrics and distort KPIs. Includes a platform or source prefix to identify the originating platform. AA12345 -> AA represents Adobe Analytics
interaction_id_source interactionIdSource Identifier for the interaction in the originating data source Connects the interaction back to its original source, enabling traceability across different platforms and data systems
interaction_dateNaming Change interactionDate Date when the interaction was generated Enables day-level analysis and identification of activity spikes, such as those tied to campaign launches or events
interaction_timestampTo Be Added interactionTimestamp Standardized timestamp of the interaction, expressed in UTC Maintains consistency across global time zones, enables identification of activity spikes by time of day, and ensures year-over-year metrics are comparable regardless of where the interaction originated
interaction_timestamp_sourceTo Be Deleted interactionTimestampSource Interaction timestamp in the source system's original time zone Captures the timestamp as recorded in the source system, making it possible to identify when spikes occurred locally. For example, activity appearing at midnight UTC may actually be midday in the source region.
interaction_timestamp_timezone interactionTimestampTimezone Time zone of the source timestamp, before conversion to UTC Records the original time zone before UTC conversion, enabling accurate time zone mapping and verification of the standardization process
interaction_type interactionType Type of interaction Enables comparison of interaction types and rates, groups interactions for easier sorting and filtering, and supports marketing segmentation, for example, targeting users who have completed at least one form interaction event, form, page, search interaction
interaction_name interactionName Standardized name and description of the interaction Ensures consistent naming of interactions and provides additional detail, distinguishing the specific action taken rather than just the category it belongs to. Human-readable label for the interaction, making data accessible and reportable across teams without requiring a technical ID lookup. event attendance, form submit, web registration
interaction_reason interactionReason Additional detail or reason for the interaction Identifies interactions that require follow-up and supports prioritization of those actions contact us, demo request
interaction_external_reference interactionExternalReference Reference ID linking to a related item in another source system Connects a specific interaction to related items across systems. Since a single customer action can create records in multiple platforms, this field links those records together for a complete view of the relationship.
Field Name Original Name Definition Use Case / Why Example
source_platform Original platform from which the interaction data was generated Groups and categorizes data by originating platform, making it possible to identify over- or underperforming platforms and understand which sources are driving the most interactions
source_code Short identifier for the source platform A shorter, standardized code for the source platform that improves readability and makes data easier to scan compared to full platform names
source_propertyType Type of property the data originated from: web or app Categorizes and enables comparison of engagement across different property types
source_originType Where the data was originally generated Indicates whether the data was generated internally via SAP systems or externally, enabling categorization and comparison by origin type
source_medium Attribute inherited from the SMC interaction schema that describes how an interaction entered SMC. For example, 'FILE' indicates the interaction was manually uploaded, while 'EMAIL' represents an email campaign interaction. Identifies the origin of interactions and supports source-level reporting, troubleshooting, and categorization and segmentation of data for deeper analysis
Marketing channel information from the respective marketing platform
Field Name Original Name Definition Use Case / Why Example
marketingExecution_channel_nameNaming Change channel.name Marketing channel associated with the interaction. Can be a custom channel defined in SAP or a standard channel generated by the analytics platform, such as paid social, organic search, paid media, or organic social. Identifies where the interaction occurred and enables measurement of campaign efficiency across channels, supporting categorization and performance comparison Event, Web, Organic Search
marketingExecution_channel_mediumNaming Change channel.medium (referrer type AA) Type or category of website traffic Provides more specific categorization within channels, enabling granular segmentation and deeper analysis of traffic types Typed Bookmark, Internal sites
marketingExecution_channel_sourceNaming Change channel.source (referring domain) Origin of website traffic Identifies where visitors are coming from, enabling tracing of the customer journey from one touchpoint to the next. Helps identify which sources generate the most interactions of a given type.
marketingExecution_channel_tacticNaming Change channel.tactic Marketing tactic per SAP definition Categorizes interactions by SAP-defined marketing tactics to ensure alignment with SAP marketing objectives and goals
marketingExecution_channel_subTacticNaming Change channel.sub_tactic Sub-marketing tactic per SAP definition Categorizes interactions by SAP-defined sub-marketing tactics to ensure alignment with SAP marketing objectives and goals
marketingExecution_channel_siteNaming Change channel.site Marketing site where the campaign is executed (Msights) Identifies the specific website where the interaction occurred, ensuring campaign execution matches what was planned
Marketing campaign information from the respective marketing platform
Field Name Original Name Definition Use Case / Why Example
marketingExecution_campaign_idNaming Change campaign.id Campaign ID in the source or external platform, if applicable Identifies the campaign in the platform where it was created and launched. This is distinct from internal SAP IDs and is specific to the campaign's execution platform.
marketingExecution_campaign_pttIdNaming Change campaign.ptt_id PTT ID of the executing campaign Unique 4-digit numeric ID used internally at SAP to document and record all marketing campaigns. A universal code that is standardized across internal SAP systems.
marketingExecution_campaign_nameNaming Change campaign.name Campaign name in the source platform, following the established taxonomy Name used by the campaign in the platform it was created in, which can be a merge of the PTT ID and the campaign name. Ties all engagement data back to a specific, human-readable campaign label. Enables teams to measure and compare campaign performance, which campaigns drive the most pipeline, leads, or engagement, without relying on technical IDs that require a lookup to interpret.
marketingExecution_campaign_externalNameNaming Change campaign.external_name Campaign name used in the external source Captures alternative names used for the campaign in external sources, ensuring the same campaign is tracked correctly across internal and external platforms
marketingExecution_campaign_placementIdNaming Change campaign.placement_id ID assigned to the campaign for use by the placement team responsible for executing it A dedicated identifier used by the execution team to reference and manage the campaign placement
marketingExecution_campaign_typeNaming Change campaign.type Type of campaign Categorizes campaigns into defined sections, enabling grouping and comparison of similar campaign types
marketingExecution_campaign_descriptionNaming Change campagin.description Description of the campaign in the source platform Provides additional context and background about the campaign as defined in the source platform
marketingExecution_campaign_accountIdNaming Change campaign.account_id Campaign account identifier in the source platform Identifies the account associated with the campaign in the source platform. Prevents ambiguity when multiple accounts share similar names or when account names change over time.
marketingExecution_campaign_accountNameNaming Change campaign.account_name Name of the account in the source platform A business-friendly name for the account that is easier to reference than a complex character ID, improving readability and usability in reports and dashboards
marketingExecution_campaign_creativeIdNaming Change campaign.creative_id Campaign creative ID in the source platform Unique identifier for each creative asset in the campaign. Enables creative-level reporting and identifies which assets deliver the best performance.
marketingExecution_campaign_adIdNaming Change campaign.ad_id Campaign advertisement ID in the source platform Identifies individual advertisement assets within the campaign, providing a unique identifier that enables ad-level reporting and analysis
marketingExecution_campaign_adTypeNaming Change campaign.ad_type Type of advertisement in the source platform Describes the advertisement type, enabling categorization and comparison of ads and providing additional context about the nature of the asset
marketingExecution_campaign_assetIdNaming Change campaign.asset_id Campaign asset ID in the source platform Unique identifier for each asset in the campaign, enabling grouping and analysis of specific assets
marketingExecution_campaign_landingPageNaming Change campaign.landing_page Landing page for the marketing campaign Link to the campaign's landing page, including its associated assets. Provides visibility into what the user sees after clicking, and enables tracking of the user journey and identification of which pages drive the most engagement.
marketingExecution_campaign_trackingCodeNaming Change campaign.tracking_code Additional tracking code associated with the campaign, derived from the landing page URL An additional code used to track campaign engagement, generated from interaction with the landing page. Supports user journey tracking alongside other campaign identifiers.
marketingExecution_campaign_trackingSourceNaming Change campaing,tracking_source External campaign metadata, typically derived from the URL UTM parameter 'source='. Identifies the originating source of the tracking data. Enables attribution reporting and identifies which external source generated the campaign traffic
marketingExecution_campaign_trackingInternalClickNaming Change campaing.tracking_internal_click Internal tracking code associated with a campaign call to action Tracks CTA engagement and measures the effectiveness of different placements and call-to-action strategies
marketingExecution_campaign_trackingExternalClickNaming Change campaing.tracking_external_click External click tracking code for the campaign, referenced as cta_id References the CTA that was clicked within the creative content to drive traffic to the SAP property. Tracks the first click that led users to SAP assets.
marketingExecution_campaign_contentNaming Change campaign.content An identifier representing a specific piece of content tracked within the marketing campaign Enables content-level analysis and attribution, identifying which pieces and styles of content perform best nurture email, ad id
marketingExecution_campaign_platformNaming Change campaign.platform Campaign execution platform name Identifies which platform the campaign was launched on, enabling categorization and comparison of performance across platforms
marketingExecution_campaign_startDateNaming Change campaign.startdate Campaign execution start date The date the campaign was officially launched. Places the campaign in the context of a broader timeline and helps ensure adherence to the planned schedule.
marketingExecution_campaign_endDateNaming Change campaign.enddate Campaign execution end date The date the campaign officially concluded. Places the campaign in the context of a broader timeline and helps ensure adherence to the planned schedule.
marketingExecution_campaign_regionNaming Change campaign.region Campaign execution region Identifies where the campaign was executed, enabling global comparison and ensuring analysis accounts for regional and cultural context
marketingExecution_campaign_marketUnitNaming Change campaign.market_unit Market unit a campaign targets or executes within. Regional information about the campaign execution, stored in CTT. Supports regional reporting and analysis by market structure, enabling performance evaluation across individual marketing units
marketingExecution_campaign_countryNaming Change campaign.country Campaign execution country Identifies the specific country where the campaign was executed, enabling global comparison and ensuring analysis accounts for regional and cultural context
marketingExecution_campaign_solutionAreaNaming Change campaign.solution_area Campaign solution area Identifies the SAP solution area the campaign targets, ensuring campaigns are addressing the correct solution areas and promoting the appropriate SAP products
marketingExecution_campaign_agencyNaming Change campaign.agency Campaign execution agency Identifies which agency was responsible for executing the campaign, ensuring proper accountability and credit attribution for campaign results
marketingExecution_campaign_inventoryTypeNaming Change campaign.inventory_type Type of content used in the campaign. Campaign metadata stored in CTT. Enables reporting and analysis by content type, identifying which content types and strategies deliver the best performance
marketingExecution_campaign_targetingTypeNaming Change campaign.targeting_type Type of targeting used in campaign execution, such as geo or language targeting. Campaign metadata stored in CTT. Supports measurement and comparison of different targeting strategies, providing insight into the campaign's goals and targeting approach
Field Name Original Name Definition Use Case / Why Example
parentPlanning_pttIdTo Be Added PTT ID of the planning line item Unique 4-digit numeric ID for campaigns, identifying the specific planning item this interaction is associated with
parentPlanning_lineItemId ID generated in the planning tool Unique identifier for the line item, used to differentiate it from other line items and enable line-item-level reporting
parentPlanning_integratedDemandPlan SAP-defined Integrated Demand Program associated with the planning line item. Defines the specific strategic demand generation program, target audience, messaging, and expected business outcomes. Connects campaign execution to the broader SAP strategy, enabling measurement and reporting in the context of business objectives and ensuring campaigns are aligned with strategic goals
parentPlanning_crmWbsCodeNaming Change parent_planning.crm_campaign CRM campaign code Non-unique ID for the line item. One campaign code can lead to multiple events.
parentPlanning_lineItemNameNaming Change parent_planning.crm_campaign_name Name of the planning line item Human-readable label for the line item. Makes data accessible and reportable across teams without requiring a technical ID lookup to understand what is being referenced.
parentPlanning_campaignObjectiveNaming Change parent_planning.crm_campaign_objective Campaign objective from the planning tool Describes the goals and objectives of the planning line item, ensuring that metrics are analyzed in the context of the intended outcomes
parentPlanning_customerJourneyStage Customer journey stage associated with the CRM campaign Connects each line item to the customer journey, enabling interactions to be viewed as part of the overall journey rather than as isolated, unrelated events

parentPlanning_activitySubtype Activity subtype selected in Allocadia/SAC Groups activities of the same subtype together, enabling more granular comparison and analysis within an activity category
parentPlanning_solutionArea Solution area selected in Allocadia/SAC Identifies the SAP solution area the campaign targets, ensuring campaigns are addressing the correct solution areas and promoting the appropriate SAP products
parentPlanning_subsolutionArea Sub-solution area selected in Allocadia/SAC Identifies the SAP sub-solution area the campaign targets, ensuring campaigns are addressing the correct sub-solution areas and promoting the appropriate SAP products
parentPlanning_createDate Planning line item creation date Identifies the specific date the line item was created and places it within the broader campaign timeline
parentPlanning_lineItemEndDate Planning line item end date The official planned end date of the planning line item. Places the item in the context of the broader campaign timeline and supports schedule adherence.
parentPlanning_lineItemStartDate Planning line item start date The official planned start date of the planning line item. Places the item in the context of the broader campaign timeline and supports schedule adherence.
parentPlanning_eventEndDate Event end date associated with the planning line item The official planned end date of the event associated with the planning line item. Supports timeline management and schedule adherence.
parentPlanning_eventStartDate Event start date associated with the planning line item The official planned start date of the event associated with the planning line item. Supports timeline management and schedule adherence.
parentPlanning_salesYearNaming Change parent_planning.year Year of line item creation Places the line item creation date within the context of the relevant sales year
parentPlanning_growthPriority Growth priority associated with the planning line item. Example: Move existing on-premise customers to SAP Business Suite — GP-021. Gives context into the goals and priorities behind the campaign, ensuring alignment with defined marketing objectives and enabling analysis and reporting in the context of those business priorities
parentPlanning_industry Industry associated with the planning line item Text name of the industry. Used to group, categorize, and compare line items across industries.
parentPlanning_industryCategory Industry category associated with the planning line item More specific than the general industry field. Used to group, categorize, and compare line items at a finer industry level.
parentPlanning_marketUnit Market unit planned to be targeted by this campaign Defines the intended geographic or organizational market focus of this initiative, supporting planning and analysis
parentPlanning_region Region associated with the planning line item Identifies where the line item was executed, enabling global comparison and ensuring analysis accounts for regional and cultural context
parentPlanning_country Country associated with the planning line item Identifies the specific country where the line item was executed, enabling global comparison and ensuring analysis accounts for regional and cultural context
parentPlanning_segment Segment of companies planned to be targeted. Example: Midmarket. Enables audience segmentation analysis and comparison of results across planned target segments, supporting evaluation of targeting success against the intended goal segment
parentPlanning_businessOwnerTo Be Added Owner of the planning line item Used to identify who is responsible for the line item, to ensure correct allocation of credit and accountability, and to know who to reach out to for more information
parentPlanning_growthPriorityId Unique ID representing the Growth Priority associated with the planning line item Provides a consistent system reference to link the campaign back to its specific Integrated Demand Plan (IDP)
parentPlanning_solutionAreaId ID of the SAP solution area associated with the line item Ensures the line item is addressing the correct SAP solution areas and promoting the appropriate SAP products
parentPlanning_subsolutionId ID of the SAP sub-solution area associated with the line item Ensures the line item is addressing the correct SAP sub-solution areas and promoting the appropriate SAP products
parentPlanning_activitySubTypeId ID of the sub-type of the activity Identifies the sub-type category the activity falls into, enabling segmentation and comparison of activities
parentPlanning_industryId ID of the industry associated with the line item Numeric identifier for the industry. Used to group, categorize, and compare line items across industries.
parentPlanning_integratedDemandPlanId ID of the Integrated Demand Plan associated with the planning line item Provides a consistent system reference to link the campaign back to its specific Integrated Demand Plan (IDP)

Field Name Original Name Definition Use Case / Why Example
marketingIntentTag[i]idNaming Change interaction_tag[i].key (BK) Semaphore ID reference associated with the interaction The specific ID used to reference the tag in data. Acts as a label identifying the interest of the customer or lead, and can be used to look up the corresponding interest in Semaphore.
marketingIntentTag[i]nameNaming Change interaction_tag[i].name Semaphore taxonomy name from the Semaphore raw data Human-readable label for the tag. Makes data accessible and reportable across teams without requiring a technical ID lookup to understand what is being referenced. Text result after using the ID to search in Semaphore.
marketingIntentTag[i]hierarchyNaming Change interaction_tag[i].hierarchy If 'ioi enabled' then get the ioi hierarchy l1,l2 from semaphore If 'solution tag enabled' then get the ioi hierarchy from the product solution hierarchy. If 'topic or industry' enabled, no hierarchy -> NA Represents the hierarchy level of the interest within the Semaphore taxonomy. Includes either the main solution area hierarchy or the sub-solution area hierarchy, depending on which tag type is enabled. Label that identifies what is the interest of the customer/lead that interacted, solution area, comes with a ID, semaphore is a taxonomy platform, get ID -> go to semaphore -> tells you what ID represents (business technical platform, HCM) also get hierarchy, sub solution area, main solution area hierarchy, some need more hierarchies instead of main solution one
marketingIntentTag[i]typeNaming Change interaction_tag[i].type Classification of the marketing intent tag, such as IOI, solution area, topic, or industry. An attribute sourced from Semaphore. Enables further categorization of customer interests, supporting segmentation, intent analysis, and personalization
Field Name Original Name Definition Use Case / Why Example
geolocation_ipAddress IP address from which the interaction data originated A unique number assigned to a network-connected device. Enables tracking of interactions down to the specific device they originated from and, in some cases, can be used to identify a single person.
geolocation_continent Continent from which the interaction data originated Enables the highest-level geographic segmentation, useful for global campaign reporting where regional teams (Americas, EMEA, APJ) need to measure reach and performance within their territory. Allows executive-level dashboards to compare engagement across major business regions without granular country-level detail.
geolocation_country Country from which the interaction data originated Primary geographic dimension for most marketing analysis. Enables country-level performance benchmarking and budget decisions. Also supports legal compliance, as privacy requirements vary by country.
geolocation_region Region from which the interaction data originated Supports sub-country analysis in large markets such as the US, Germany, and Brazil where regional differences are meaningful. Enables performance analysis across regions to support campaign adjustments.
geolocation_city City from which the interaction data originated Enables hyper-local targeting and analysis, particularly useful for in-person event planning and account-based marketing where proximity to a customer's headquarters matters. Can also be used to validate whether paid campaigns are delivering in the intended cities.
geolocation_zipcode Zip code from which the interaction data originated The most granular geographic field, used for highly targeted direct marketing, account-based campaigns, or analysis of specific metro areas within a city. Also supports data enrichment workflows where zip code is used to append additional firmographic or demographic data to a contact record.
Field Name Original Name Definition Use Case / Why Example
device_category Category of the device from which the interaction originated Enables measurement and comparison of performance across device types to optimize campaign delivery. Some campaigns perform differently across device categories. desktop/mobile/tablet
device_operatingSystem Operating system the device uses Enables comparison of campaign performance across different operating systems, identifying which environments deliver the best results windows, os, etc
device_operatingSystemVersion Exact version of the operating system the device uses Enables comparison of campaign performance across different operating system versions, identifying whether newer or older versions impact results
device_language Language the device uses Enables measurement of performance differences across device languages, identifying whether translation or localization issues are impacting campaign results
device_webInfo_browser Web browser the device uses Enables comparison of campaign performance across different web browsers, identifying which environments deliver the best user experience and results
device_webInfo_browserVersion Exact version of the web browser the device uses Enables comparison of campaign performance across different browser versions, identifying whether newer or older versions impact results
device_userAgent A string sent by a browser or application that identifies the device and operating system Enables analysis of customer interactions by device and browser type, helping to optimize digital experiences across platforms and technologies
Field Name Original Name Definition Use Case / Why Example
event_pttIdTo Be Added PTT ID associated with the event Unique 4-digit numeric ID for campaigns, identifying the specific one associated with this event. Links the event back to its parent campaign.
event_id Unique identifier associated with the event Connects all data related to a specific event, enabling event-level reporting and analysis
event_name Text name of the event Ties all engagement data (registrations, attendance, form fills) back to a specific, human-readable event label. Enables teams to measure and compare event performance, which events drive the most pipeline, leads, or engagement, without relying on technical IDs that require a lookup to interpret. SAPPHIRE 2035
event_attendanceType Type of attendance in the event Defines the type of attendance expected for the event, so that planning can align with the relevant attendance format requirements hybrid, in person, virtual
event_ownership Who owns this event Identifies who is responsible for the event and who to contact for more information or support SAP hosting, 3rd party
event_location Where the event is being hosted Identifies the specific city where an in-person event is held, or indicates if the event is virtual Online, City
event_category Category the event falls into Groups events of the same category together, enabling categorization and comparison of event performance by type Sapphire, Innovation day
event_registrationPlatformNaming Change event.registration_platform Platform used for event registration Identifies the source of registration data and where to investigate if registration issues arise on24, Sap.com
event_attendancePlatformTo Be Added Platform used to track event attendance Identifies the source of attendance data and where to investigate if attendance tracking issues arise on24, Sap.com
event_startDate Event start date The official planned start date of the event. Places the event in the context of the broader campaign timeline and supports schedule adherence.
event_endDate Event end date The official planned end date of the event. Places the event in the context of the broader campaign timeline and supports schedule adherence.
event_attendanceDurationPercentageTo Be Added The percentage of the event duration a person was present for, based on their interaction with an online event or event VOD Measures how long a participant was engaged with the event. Supports event reporting, success measurement, and identification of attendee interest levels.

page_siteName Global variable for the site that hosts the page Identifies which domain the interaction occurred on, enables segmentation and reporting across different sites, and supports cross-site tracking
page_id Sequence of characters used to identify the page Unique identifier for the page, used to track and analyze page-level engagement and reporting
page_title Title of the page in the browser The human-readable title of the page, providing insight into the page's content and improving readability and usability in reports
page_rawUrl Raw URL of the page including protocol, domain, path, and query string parameters Full page URL before any edits or processing. Captures all parameters and details as originally recorded.
page_url URL of the page without query string parameters Simplified page URL that improves data readability and makes it easier to analyze page-level performance without query string noise
page_queryString Page query string parameters Captures the query string portion of the URL separately, enabling cleaner page-level analysis and making it easier to extract and work with URL parameters without parsing them from the full raw URL each time

*** URL of the page that sent the user to the current page, where they came from Enables tracking of the user journey by identifying which pages drive traffic to others. Used for attribution analysis, identifying high-performing referral sources, and understanding navigation paths that lead to conversions.
page_name Name of the page Human-readable label for the page. Makes data accessible and reportable across teams without requiring a technical ID lookup to understand what is being referenced.
page_detail Extra detail about the page Provides additional background and context about the page and its content, supporting more detailed analysis
page_section Page path or subdirectory Identifies which section of the website the page belongs to, used to categorize and organize the site structure for analysis Dashboard, content, technology
page_template Template the page was built upon Identifies the structural template used to build the page. Enables performance comparison across page types and ensures page design follows established templates. Product page, Landing page
page_breadcrumb[]Naming Change page.breadcrumbs[] Breadcrumb navigation of the page Places the page within the context of the breadcrumb navigation structure. Used to categorize and organize pages, identify which sections of the website users are interacting with, and follow the user's website navigation journey.
page_language Language used by the page Enables measurement of performance differences across page languages, identifying whether translation or localization issues are impacting engagement
page_country Country of the page Identifies the specific country associated with the page, enabling global comparison and ensuring analysis accounts for regional and cultural context
page_canonical Canonical URL of the page, used to indicate the preferred version when duplicate or similar content exists across multiple URLs ***
page_accessLevel Access level of the page Determines the sensitivity of the page's content and dictates who can or cannot access it. Important for ensuring the security and protection of SAP assets. public, gated

form_contactRequested Whether the form included a 'contact me' input, usually a checkbox that allows the user to opt in to being contacted by a sales representative Represents lead intent, as a user who requests contact is likely highly interested. Supports routing and prioritization of engaged users, and enables conversion analysis to identify which forms drive the most contact requests.
form_optinStatus Opt-in consent status selected by the user Supports legal compliance, as some regions require explicit opt-in consent. Determines future engagement with the contact and helps ensure consent is being captured correctly across forms.

form_newsletter[n]Naming Change form.newsletters[n] Newsletter(s) a form offers as a signup option, which can include multiple newsletters Tracks which newsletter subscriptions are being driven by which pages or forms, supporting personalization and segmentation
form_companyNameOrigin The method by which the company name field was populated Signals data quality and user behavior, giving insight for lead quality analysis. For example, prefilled values from 6sense or Marketo tend to be more reliable than free-text entries. Filled manually, autocomplete, name was submitted before from cookies, prefilled from Marketo
form_contactProfileLevel The completeness or richness of the contact profile submitted with the form Scores or classifies how much data was captured about the person. Used to prioritize leads or assess data quality downstream.
form_stepName Name of the currently viewed step of a multi-step form Supports funnel analysis by tracking which step a user is on when they abandon the form. Enables step-level analysis of how users interact at each stage of the form and helps identify where issues occur.
form_language Language the form is using Enables analysis of form engagement and conversion across languages, identifying whether anything is lost in translation

For example, if the industry filter is used more than the language filter, industry-based segmentation is more important.
search_filter[i]nameNaming Change filters[i].name The specific value selected by the user within the filter category Identifies content gaps. For example, if users filter by a content type and get no results. Also helps optimize filters by flagging categories that are rarely used.

search_clickTitle Title of the search result that was clicked Measures the effectiveness of search result titles in driving engagement and enables content performance analysis
search_clickCategory Category of the search result that was clicked Helps understand which type of content is most relevant to users, enabling category-level reporting and analysis
